games.title: It Takes Two
games.description: Embark on the craziest journey of your life in It Takes Two. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend’s Pass and work together across a huge variety of gleefully disruptive gameplay challenges. Winner of GAME OF THE YEAR at the Game Awards 2021.

games.title: Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR'S CUT
games.description: A storm is coming. Venture into the complete Ghost of Tsushima DIRECTOR’S CUT on PC; forge your own path through this open-world action adventure and uncover its hidden wonders. Brought to you by Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software and PlayStation Studios.

games.title: Worst Class Ever
games.description: 1 Teacher vs 7 Students. Hide. Prank. Survive. Up to 8-player asymmetric party chaos! Mischievous students blend into dozens of NPC classmates, secretly snacking, texting, and causing trouble, while the teacher must spot these wannabe delinquents and restore complete order to the classroom.

games.title: Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered
games.description: In Marvel’s Spider-Man Remastered, the worlds of Peter Parker and Spider-Man collide in an original action-packed story. Play as an experienced Peter Parker, fighting big crime and iconic villains in Marvel’s New York. Web-swing through vibrant neighborhoods and defeat villains with epic takedowns.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE
games.description: Cloud Strife, an ex-SOLDIER operative, descends on the mako-powered city of Midgar. The world of the timeless classic FINAL FANTASY VII is reborn, using cutting-edge graphics technology, a new battle system and an additional adventure featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.

games.title: Forza Horizon 6
games.description: Discover the breathtaking landscapes of Japan in over 550 real-world cars and become a racing Legend in Forza Horizon's biggest open world driving adventure yet.

games.title: FINAL FANTASY VII REBIRTH
games.description: The Unknown Journey Continues... After escaping the city of Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out on a journey across the planet. New adventures await in a vibrant, expansive world in this standalone entry of the FFVII remake trilogy.

games.title: Crimson Desert Enhanced
games.description: Crimson Desert is an open-world action-adventure set on the continent of Pywel. Join Kliff on his journey to rebuild the Greymane faction and to save the land from a looming threat. From vast wilderness and cities to ruins and the mysterious Abyss, forge your path through battles and discovery.

games.title: God of War
games.description: His vengeance against the Gods of Olympus years behind him, Kratos now lives as a man in the realm of Norse Gods and monsters. It is in this harsh, unforgiving world that he must fight to survive… and teach his son to do the same.

games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.description: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

games.title: Model Builder: Complete Edition
games.description: Join the latest trend in simulation games, bring out your creativity and make awesome-looking models with the base game and all available DLCs. Assemble, customize and display your creations, whether you’re a veteran or a novice. Get building, and get creative!

games.title: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
games.description: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

games.title: Bread and Fred
games.description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.title: Eternal Threads
games.description: Eternal Threads is a single-player, first-person story-driven puzzle game of time manipulation, choice and consequence.

games.title: Ghostrunner 2
games.description: Ghostrunner 2 is a hardcore FPP slasher set in a post-apocalyptic, cyberpunk world. Featuring everything fans loved about Ghostrunner plus incredible boss fights, new interactive story, thrilling motorbike levels, improved skills, and more cyber ninja action.

games.title: Lost Castle: The Old Ones Awaken
games.description: The Old Ones Awaken adds new levels to explore, new enemies to defeat, and new bosses to face along with a host exciting new weapons and equipment to wield and wear.

games.title: LISA: The Definitive Edition
games.description: Explore Olathe and unmask its twisted secrets with LISA: The Definitive Edition, including the original narrative-driven RPG LISA: The Painful and its sequel LISA: The Joyful.

games.title: Castlevania Anniversary Collection
games.description: Konami's Castlevania Anniversary Collection traces the origins of the historic vampire franchise. Included is a unique eBook with details provided by developers, artists and others inspired by the Castlevania legacy which sheds a fresh light into the world of Castlevania.

games.title: Mark of the Deep
games.description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!

games.title: Monument Valley
games.description: Embark on a journey of forgiveness through impossible environments and illusionary puzzles. Experience this meditative and calming puzzle game by manipulating monuments and creating evolving paths to explore new, surreal, and mysterious worlds.

games.title: Luftrausers
games.description: The skies are aflame and the seas will overflow with wreckage in Vlambeer’s stylish arcade shooter LUFTRAUSERS! Take to the skies in customized fighter planes to battle battleships, submarines, and rival aces for glory, honor, and high scores.

games.title: TerraScape
games.description: Build gorgeous kingdoms on floating islands by strategically placing buildings in this cozy, medieval City-Puzzler. Discover secret combinations, take on monthly challenges and explore randomly generated maps in various single- and multiplayer game modes.

games.title: Knightica
games.description:
Recruit units, place them strategically, and find the synergies in this Roguelike AutoBattler!
Knightica lets you guide a warband through challenges to free the Kingdoms.
Discover combinations, weave powerful enchants, face dangerous monsters, and lead your army to victory!

games.title: LANDSHIPS - WW1 Tanks
games.description: Command a First World War landship in fierce tank battles. Pick one of six heavy, medium or light tanks and fight across the Western Front, a desert oasis and snowy Cambrai 1917 in Capture the Flag or Last Man Standing. Earn medals and crates. Be the last tank rolling.

games.title: No Man's Village
games.description: A WWII voxel extraction shooter. Raid an occupied Normandy village alone or with up to three friends, take everything you can carry, and get out alive before the bombers come.

games.title: Phone Shop Simulator
games.description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

games.title: Last Keep: Banner of War
games.description: A first-person pixel-art castle defense. By day, shop in a cozy castle town, decorate your keep and pet the cat. At dusk, ring the bell: torches ignite and goblins pour out of the forest mist. Hold the gate with crossbow, spells and bombs for 25 nights, up to the Goblin King.

games.title: Chip Builder
games.description: A story-driven puzzle game about digital logic. Wire transistors into gates, gates into adders and memory, and memory into a working CPU you program yourself. Then take your design to the fab and make a real chip.

games.title: Underleaf
games.description: You are a bug, and you’ll have to fight to stay alive. Eat, explore, grow, team up when you need to, and conquer the garden through your offspring, generation after generation.

games.title: Cricket Club President
games.description: A cricket club management game. You are the president. Pick three sides from one squad every week, keep the captain and the committee onside, sign sponsors, hire staff and build up the ground, then win the AGM vote to stay on next season.

games.title: slay through hell
games.description: Descend 100 floors of Hell in a solo, turn-based roguelike deckbuilder. Face 100+ monster types across 10 regions and 40 maps to a soundtrack of over 40 tracks. Restore Fragments and bind Soulfire to your cards. Equip Soul Relics, light Prayer Candles, and awaken Soul Power.

games.title: Brave Dungeon: The Meaning of Justice
games.description: This sequel retains the core gameplay systems of the original Brave Dungeon while introducing three distinct stories, each featuring a different protagonist and its own unique gameplay system.

games.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2
games.description:
Mankind is in peril. The Imperium needs you. 

Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor’s warriors, unleashing deadly abilities and devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes.

games.title: Global Conflict Simulator
games.description: Lead a nation solo or with up to 7 friends as allies or rivals. Build bases, wage war and command your forces in strategic combat. Talk with AI-powered leaders, navigate diplomacy, make promises and post on in-game social media as the world reacts to your decisions.

games.title: WilderDecks
games.description: A tavern card game with an AI art creator on your own PC: infinite generation, no credits. Name a card, watch your PC paint it and choose from four playable versions. Win to keep up to two of the cards you forged. Solo road or online tables for up to four. One purchase.

games.title: Le Fishe
games.description: Le Fishe is a cozy fishing adventure where every cast of your line leads to something new. Catch a wide variety of fish, upgrade your fishing gear, and unlock new locations as you progress.

games.title: Mudlands Rally
games.description: Arcade rally racing through deep mud, rain and city streets. Three careers, 80 tracks, custom tournaments, crumpling arcade damage and split screen for up to 4 players.

games.title: Reversi: Starlight Tournament
games.description: Play 8x8 Reversi with 8 characters and 7 story routes! Master corners, stable discs, and mobility. Enjoy interactive tutorials, 7 AI difficulty levels in Free Battle, and support for 5 languages.

games.title: Quizune
games.description: A general knowledge quiz with over 100,000 questions: history, science, art, literature, music, movies, video games, anime and more. Explore a 3D world where a kitsune guides you from theme to theme.

games.title: Football Manager 27
games.description: Choose the club. Shape the squad. Set the tactics as the manager of the world’s greatest football clubs. FM27 is where footballing beliefs become reality in a living, breathing football world that blends strategy with RPG in the ultimate sports simulation game.

games.title: Fall Guys
games.description: Fall Guys is a free, cross-platform massively multiplayer party royale game. Clumsily compete in absurd obstacle courses with friends or build your very own chaotic course to share with the community.

games.title: The Alters
games.description: Explore an emotional sci-fi game that features a unique blend of adventure, survival, and base-building elements. Play as Jan Dolski, a simple worker who creates alternative versions of himself in a desperate attempt to escape from a planet where even sun rays can prove deadly.

games.title: Tile Match Rush
games.description: Tile Match Rush is a fast-paced tile-matching puzzle game. Match 3 tiles, clear tricky boards, use smart power-ups, and progress through hundreds of handcrafted levels. Easy to learn, challenging to master.

games.title: Honeybun Hill
games.description: Honeybun Hill is a cozy sandbox where you can explore a vast world filled with unique towns, build your dream home, raise animals, and do quests for Kingdoms.

games.title: Zeal Demo
games.description: Playable demo of Zeal.

games.title: Sci-Fi Space Battle
games.description: Fly hard. Cut the supply. Take the hangar. Sci-Fi Space Battle combines fast ship combat with a team fight for power across industrial space arenas. Build relay towers, defend your power grid and break the enemy line.

games.title: Patience
games.description: Solitaire at night, in your flat. The deck has one card too many. Lay it on the table and something answers. A one-bit horror game in black ink on white paper, where every wrong card brings its own terrors.

games.title: Naïl: Under the Roots
games.description: A cute top-down action roguelite. Naïl, a baby mole, follows the roots of a withering great tree underground — parry to the beat and free the neighbors bound by purple threads.

games.title: Total War: WARHAMMER II
games.description: Journey to the mysterious New World, and wage campaigns of adventure and conquest in the critically-acclaimed second chapter of the Total War: WARHAMMER series!
